Key Takeaways

  • GHMC property tax is paid against a PTIN (Property Tax Identification Number).
  • A clean, up-to-date property tax record is asked for in loans, sales and mutations.
  • We retrieve your PTIN, current dues, payment history and paid receipts.
  • Unpaid arrears attract penalties and can complicate a sale — we help you see and clear them.
  • Handled remotely with your property details.

The GHMC property tax receipt is a small document that says a lot: that the property is on the municipal record, correctly assessed, and paid up. Banks, buyers and the mutation process all look for it.

JaaGa retrieves your PTIN and property tax status — dues, history and paid receipts — and helps you keep the record clean.

When You Need Tax Receipts

For a home loan or loan-against-property file, where the latest paid receipt is standard.

Before selling or mutating a property, to prove there are no outstanding tax arrears.

Common Problems We Solve

Lost or unknown PTIN

We locate the PTIN from the property address and owner details.

Hidden arrears

Older unpaid dues plus penalties can surprise sellers. We surface the full picture.

Assessment mismatches

Wrong built-up area or usage inflates tax. We help identify assessment errors.

Why Property Tax Receipt (GHMC) Matters

Property tax arrears don't just cost penalties — they stall sales and mutations, because buyers and offices want to see a clean, paid record. Keeping the receipt current is a small task that prevents a last-minute deal blocker.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a PTIN?

The Property Tax Identification Number under which GHMC assesses and records property tax for your property.

I don't know my PTIN — can you find it?

Yes. With the property address and owner name we can locate the PTIN and record.

Why do I need the latest tax receipt?

It is standard in loan files and is checked before sale and mutation to confirm there are no arrears.

Can you help clear arrears?

We surface the dues and penalties and guide you through clearing them; the payment itself is made by the owner.

Can NRIs get this remotely?

Yes. Share your details on WhatsApp and we retrieve everything digitally.
